intro.lede: What LIA can do, what each building block is for, what it relies on, and how the blocks chain together when you talk to her.

g.converse.name: Conversing and understanding
g.converse.summary: The conversation thread, understanding each request, and the two ways to carry it out: a verified plan, or an autonomous loop.

g.remember.name: Remembering and knowing you
g.remember.summary: What LIA remembers about you, how she rereads it, and the personality she shows you — everything is visible and can be corrected.

g.act.name: Acting in your services
g.act.summary: Your real accounts and services: email, calendar, contacts, files, places, web, third-party tools. LIA acts on your behalf, never without your approval for what matters.

g.know.name: Knowing and producing
g.know.summary: Your documents made searchable, and what LIA makes for you: documents, images, meeting minutes.

g.initiative.name: Taking the initiative
g.initiative.summary: What LIA does without being asked — at the right time, within limits you set, and always recorded in the register.

g.voice.name: Speaking
g.voice.summary: Voice in three forms: dictating and listening, conversing in real time, and the phone.

g.trust.name: Trust and control
g.trust.summary: Who accesses what, what is traced, what each action costs, and the settings that keep all of it in your hands.

f.chat.name: Conversation
f.chat.role: The single thread where you talk to LIA, in writing or by voice: streamed answers, attachments, visual cards and the cost shown under each answer.
f.chat.goal: Answer accurately and fast, in a single thread, showing what each answer cost.

f.routing.name: Understanding the request
f.routing.role: Reads each message: plain chat or a request to carry out, the domains involved (calendar, email…), the language; then ranks the tools by relevance.
f.routing.goal: Send each request down the right path without spending more than needed.

f.planning.name: Planning (Pipeline mode)
f.planning.role: Turns a request into a typed plan — steps, dependencies, loops over a list — checks it, then runs the independent steps in parallel.
f.planning.goal: The default mode: deterministic and frugal, four to eight times fewer tokens than an autonomous loop.

f.react.name: ReAct mode
f.react.role: An autonomous reasoning ↔ tools loop for open-ended requests: tools picked by relevance, a budget that extends as long as the loop keeps producing results, and a bounded recovery pass when a fact is missing.
f.react.goal: Explore when the path isn't known in advance, and end with a result obtained or a gap declared.

f.hitl.name: Human approval
f.hitl.role: Nothing sensitive goes out without your approval: email and event drafts, deletions, batches over a list. Each draft can be reviewed, edited or rejected, one at a time.
f.hitl.goal: Stay in control of everything that acts on your behalf.

f.context.name: Context and references
f.context.role: Remembers what was just shown: “the second one”, “the one for tomorrow” or “reply to them” are resolved without repeating anything.
f.context.goal: Talk to LIA as you would to someone who follows the conversation.

f.provenance.name: Provenance and honesty
f.provenance.role: Each answer says where its facts come from — sources, tools used — and states a failure as it is, without inventing a diagnosis.
f.provenance.goal: Being able to trust an answer because you can check it.

f.subagents.name: Delegated sub-agents
f.subagents.role: A long or specialized task can be handed to a sub-agent, within a bounded budget.
f.subagents.goal: Split up a big request without letting the spending explode.

f.sandbox.name: Ephemeral Python computation
f.sandbox.role: For a calculation a model does badly, LIA writes a short script and runs it in an isolated sandbox; the network goes through a single proxy, and your keys are never visible inside it.
f.sandbox.goal: Exact figures rather than estimates, without ever exposing your data or your keys.

f.memory.name: Long-term memory
f.memory.role: Facts, preferences and working instructions extracted from your conversations in the background; each memory can be seen and corrected, and keeps its history when it changes.
f.memory.goal: No need to repeat what LIA already knows about you.

f.journals.name: Journals and portrait
f.journals.role: LIA keeps her own reflection notebooks and compiles your portrait from four sources — memories, interests, habits, relationships — saying which ones she was able to read.
f.journals.goal: An understanding of you that sharpens over time, and stays readable.

f.psyche.name: Psyche and face
f.psyche.role: An emotional state that evolves over your exchanges, shapes tone and voice, and animates LIA's eyes and face.
f.psyche.goal: A coherent presence rather than a monotone machine.

f.personality.name: Personalities
f.personality.role: LIA's style — warm, concise, professional… — chosen by you and applied everywhere she speaks, phone included.
f.personality.goal: An assistant who speaks the way you prefer.

f.habits.name: Learned habits
f.habits.role: Deterministic, explainable statistics on when you do what; each habit can be seen, corrected or blocked, and a single switch turns off all learning.
f.habits.goal: Anticipate without guessing, and without learning anything behind your back.

f.interests.name: Interests
f.interests.role: The topics that matter to you, learned from your conversations, which feed discoveries sent at the right time.
f.interests.goal: Point out what really interests you, without noise.

f.relations.name: Relationships
f.relations.role: One card per person that gathers your exchanges, and a debrief written once a day: where you stand, what to bring up.
f.relations.goal: Never lose track of your relationships again.

f.openloops.name: Open loops
f.openloops.role: Commitments made in passing — “I'll get back to you tomorrow” — are spotted and no longer get lost.
f.openloops.goal: Keep what was promised, by you and by LIA alike.

f.bookmarks.name: Kept answers
f.bookmarks.role: An answer you keep becomes a copy that belongs to you: it survives a reset, can be exported, and LIA can find it again.
f.bookmarks.goal: Keep what has value, outside the conversation that produced it.

f.peers.name: Peer connections
f.peers.role: Link two LIA accounts: pass messages to each other through the assistant, hand tickets to each other.

f.connectors.name: Connectors
f.connectors.role: Google, Microsoft, Apple and the services that run on your own key; a single consent flow per provider, one active provider per category. Keyless services are enabled for everyone by the administrator.
f.connectors.goal: Connect your real accounts once, and have them stay connected.

f.mail.name: Emails
f.mail.role: Read cleaned-up emails, summarize each one only once, search, write, reply and read attachments — sending always goes through an approved draft.
f.mail.goal: Handle your inbox in a few sentences.

f.calendar.name: Calendar
f.calendar.role: View, search, create, move and delete events, with guests, reminders and time zones.

f.contacts.name: Contacts
f.contacts.role: Find someone, their contact details and birthdays, create or update a contact card.
f.contacts.goal: Know who you mean when you say “write to Marie”.

f.tasks.name: Tasks
f.tasks.role: Your to-do lists with your provider: add, check off, move, find.
f.tasks.goal: Never forget what is left to do.

f.drive.name: Files
f.drive.role: Search and read your online files, and link a whole folder — subfolders included — to a knowledge space.
f.drive.goal: Find a document by what it contains.

f.places.name: Places, routes and weather
f.places.role: Places, routes, weather and air quality; your last known location is used everywhere, always with its age.
f.places.goal: Answer “how do I get there” and “what will the weather be like” with fresh data.

f.health.name: Health
f.health.role: Health signals — steps and heart rate — sent from your phone, aggregated and read in context.
f.health.goal: Take your condition into account, without playing doctor.

f.web.name: Web and browsing
f.web.role: Web search, encyclopedia, page reading, and an automated browser for sites that require one.
f.web.goal: Fetch up-to-date information, with sources to back it up.

f.mcp.name: MCP servers
f.mcp.role: Plug in third-party tools that follow the MCP standard — old and new revisions of the protocol, OAuth included.
f.mcp.goal: Extend LIA without waiting for a native integration.

f.skills.name: Skills and plugins
f.skills.role: Skills following the Agent Skills standard and plugins following the Agent Plugins standard, installed in one go with a component-by-component report.

f.rag.name: Knowledge spaces
f.rag.role: Your documents, online folders, email labels and kept answers, indexed and retrieved through hybrid search — by meaning and by words.
f.rag.goal: Have LIA answer with what you already know, source cited.

f.documents.name: Generated documents
f.documents.role: Word reports, PowerPoint presentations, Excel workbooks and PDFs laid out by the rendering engine, with no overflow; a gallery keeps your files.
f.documents.goal: Go from research to a clean deliverable.

f.images.name: Generated images
f.images.role: Create or edit an image with several providers, each with its own formats and its price shown.
f.images.goal: Illustrate an idea in one sentence.

f.meetings.name: Meetings
f.meetings.role: Record a meeting from your phone or computer and get structured minutes, in an automatically chosen template.
f.meetings.goal: Attend the meeting, not the note-taking.

f.heartbeat.name: Autonomous heartbeat
f.heartbeat.role: At regular intervals, LIA checks whether she has something useful to tell you — an incoming email wakes her too — then decides under strict eligibility rules.
f.heartbeat.goal: Speak at the right time, or stay quiet.

f.initiative.name: In-turn initiative
f.initiative.role: After an action, LIA can follow up on her own with what's called for: notify, check, suggest the next step.
f.initiative.goal: Finish the job, not just the sentence.

f.moments.name: Anticipated moments
f.moments.role: Come back at the moment that counts: right after a meeting, or when an email you were waiting for arrives.
f.moments.goal: A question at the right moment beats a reminder at random.

f.briefing.name: Daily briefing
f.briefing.role: The home page: agenda, emails, weather, reminders and a summary, read only once per page load.
f.briefing.goal: See where you stand at a glance.

f.routines.name: Routines
f.routines.role: Scheduled actions, recurring or conditional — including watching for an expected email — with the week's history.
f.routines.goal: Delegate what recurs, without thinking about it.

f.reminders.name: Reminders
f.reminders.role: A reminder that goes off at the set time and can repeat, worded by LIA at the moment it goes off.
f.reminders.goal: Stop forgetting, no sticky notes needed.

f.workboard.name: Workboard
f.workboard.role: Tickets handed to LIA or to a peer: lifecycle, questions asked on the ticket, result and cost.
f.workboard.goal: Hand off work that outgrows a conversation.

f.notifications.name: Notifications and channels
f.notifications.role: Web and mobile notifications, and Telegram; a notification sent by LIA is an action recorded in the register.
f.notifications.goal: Reach you where you are, without ever doing it silently.

f.activity.name: Activity and proposals
f.activity.role: Everything LIA did on her own, read from her registers, and her proposals awaiting your decision.

f.voice.name: Voice mode
f.voice.role: Dictate your messages, listen to the answers, wake LIA with a word; the voice follows the mood.
f.voice.goal: Use LIA with your hands full.

f.live.name: Live mode
f.live.role: A real-time voice conversation on your own key; every request for data or action is delegated to LIA's engine, under the same rules as the chat.
f.live.goal: Talk naturally, without losing approval or traceability.

f.telephony.name: Phone
f.telephony.role: LIA calls you on a verified number or calls a third party for you; what you say on the phone becomes your own message in the chat.

f.security.name: Accounts and security
f.security.role: Server-side cookie sessions, two-factor authentication, activation by an administrator, a caller address that cannot be spoofed.
f.security.goal: Make sure your account is accessible to you alone.

f.privacy.name: Data and privacy
f.privacy.role: Three registers — actions, consultations, decisions — that the instance can seal into a per-account chain; a full export of your data; forgetting; traceability in the sense of Article 12 of the AI Act.
f.privacy.goal: Know what LIA did, read and decided — and be able to take it all with you or erase it all.

f.costs.name: Costs and quotas
f.costs.role: Every euro the platform pays is traced, shown and attributed to the right person; one ceiling per account and a daily budget for the instance.
f.costs.goal: No invisible spending, no unbounded spending.

f.llmconfig.name: Models and reasoning
f.llmconfig.role: Each of LIA's roles runs on the model the administrator chose, from among several providers, with its own thinking level and context window.
f.llmconfig.goal: The right model for each task, at the right price.

f.admin.name: Settings and administration
f.admin.role: Personal settings and pinned shortcuts; for the administrator, one switch per capability, the capability map and settings search.

f.diagnostics.name: Self-diagnostics
f.diagnostics.role: LIA reads her own telemetry, diagnoses her incidents with evidence to back it up, and works around a known failure instead of enduring it.
f.diagnostics.goal: An assistant who knows when she isn't well.

f.product.name: Product and demonstrator
f.product.role: The public demonstrator, feedback on answers, and the product metrics that guide how LIA evolves.
f.product.goal: Show LIA without risk, and improve her based on facts.

flow.ask.name: A request becomes an action
flow.ask.summary: The default path, in Pipeline mode: understand, plan, get approval, execute, report back.
steps: You write: “send Marie this morning's report”.
The request is recognized as actionable; the email and contacts domains are detected.
“The report” is found among what was just shown.
A typed plan is written and checked: find Marie, prepare the email.
Marie is found in your contacts.
The draft is shown to you: you approve, edit or reject it.
The email goes out from your own account.
The answer says what was done; the action is recorded in the register.

flow.react.name: An open question, in ReAct mode
flow.react.summary: When the path isn't known in advance, the loop explores — and ends with a result or a declared gap.
steps: “I'm driving to my brother's tomorrow: how do I get there by 7 pm?”
The available tools are ranked by relevance to this question.
The loop reasons and calls its tools one after another.
Your brother's address is found.
Route, departure time and the weather on arrival.
A fact is missing? It is declared, and a bounded recovery pass looks for it again.
The answer says what was obtained, and what could not be.

flow.initiative.name: LIA takes the initiative
flow.initiative.summary: An outside signal, a careful decision, a message that says it comes from LIA.
steps: An important email arrives: your provider's notification wakes LIA up.
The heartbeat weighs it up: is it useful, is it the right time?
Your usual rhythm weighs in the decision.
You're in a meeting? LIA waits.
The notification goes out — recorded in the register as an action.
The message appears in your thread, tinted to show that LIA spoke first.

flow.live.name: A real-time voice conversation
flow.live.summary: Two intelligences and one seam: the voice converses, LIA's engine acts.
steps: You open a Live session on your own key.
The voice model listens and answers in the same breath.
“What do I have tomorrow?” is delegated to LIA's engine as an ordinary turn.
The calendar is read under the same rules as in the chat.
A sensitive action? The approval question becomes the spoken answer.
At the end, a card sums up the session and what it cost.

flow.learn.name: LIA gets to know you
flow.learn.summary: What is said in passing becomes a memory, an interest, a habit — all of them visible.
steps: You mention that you're allergic to nuts.
The fact is extracted in the background, filed, and can be corrected.
Topics that keep coming up become interests.
The times when you do things become habits, visible and blockable.
LIA compiles your portrait and says which sources she read.
Her mood and tone adjust to the relationship.

flow.knowledge.name: What you know, LIA reads
flow.knowledge.summary: Your sources become a searchable corpus, cited in every answer.
steps: You link an online folder: its subfolders count, and the exact number of files is announced.
Or an email label: only the threads that carry it are indexed.
Documents are split up, indexed, and found by meaning and by words.
A question finds the right passage, cited with its source.
A kept answer joins your space and can be found again.

flow.costs.name: Every euro counted
flow.costs.summary: From the call to the register: priced at the moment it is made, bounded before, shown after.
steps: Before each paid call: the account's ceiling and the instance's budget are checked.
The rate comes from the catalogue: time window, cache, peak days.
The cost is shown under the answer, in the same unit for every service.
The spend is attributed to the right account and to its author: you, a routine, or LIA.
The administrator sees the spend per person and per service.

flow.ticket.name: A ticket handed over
flow.ticket.summary: Work that outgrows a conversation, with its questions and its result.
steps: You create “organize the seminar” and hand it to LIA.
LIA carries it out with your tools, in the mode chosen for this ticket.
An action to confirm? The ticket moves to “To confirm”, with the card attached.
You're notified; your comment is the answer.
Result, cost and history stay on the ticket.

flow.meeting.name: A recorded meeting
flow.meeting.summary: From the recording to the minutes, then to the right question at the right time.
steps: The “+” turns your phone or computer into a recorder.
The audio is transcribed segment by segment.
Structured minutes are written in the automatically chosen template.
They join a knowledge space.
Right after, LIA may ask you how the meeting went.
